node_id.description: Stable identifier for each HKG node.

normalized_difficulty.description: Curriculum-relative normalized score derived from stage_label.

source_type.description: Type of source used to verify stage assignment.

source_reference.description: Locator such as curriculum-standard item, textbook volume/chapter/section, or problem-collection identifier. Copyrighted passages are not included.

synonyms.description: Textbook terms, formula names, notation variants, and paraphrases linked to this node.

scope_note.description: Boundary note for cross-stage split, ambiguous form, excluded advanced variant, or operator scope.

notes: Prerequisite ordering is represented by stage_label and normalized_difficulty, not by separate prerequisite edges.
When the same surface form has different curriculum scopes, separate scope-qualified nodes are used.
